name: Hessen Jill
source:
"You are not afraid of forgetting God."

Kaina's adoptive father.

He took Kaina from "Tenkei no Kai" and came to Uchimori about two years ago. He is a foreigner who is fluent in Japanese.

He is as shunned by the townspeople because he's a mysterious foreigner who took in Kaina.

[Translated from [url=http://dswtc.web.fc2.com/game/getemono/getemono.html]official website[/url]]
